jobs.title: School Security Guard
jobs.description:
At Awty, we believe that students learn best, and faculty perform best in a culture of vibrant diversity. Diversity is an essential quality of our school environment; our commitment to learning and the pursuit of excellence can occur only in such a context. It helps us guide our students to become responsible world citizens. Our commitment to learning about and respecting one another’s diversity brings distinct richness to the Awty experience for students, alumni, employees, and parents.

Position Overview

The School Security Guard is responsible for managing and directing traffic flow around school grounds during arrival and dismissal times to ensure the safety of students, staff, and visitors. This position involves coordinating pedestrian and vehicle traffic, enforcing school traffic policies, and working in close collaboration with school administrators, local law enforcement, and community members to maintain safe traffic conditions.

Responsibilities: Essential job functions may include, but are not limited to:

  • Direct and control vehicle and pedestrian traffic during peak times, including student drop-off and pick-up hours.
  • Ensure smooth and safe traffic flow around the school, minimizing congestion and reducing the risk of accidents.
  • Coordinate with other traffic control personnel, school staff, and local authorities to ensure efficient traffic patterns around the school.
  • Ensure that drivers, pedestrians, and cyclists adhere to school traffic regulations and safety rules.
  • Monitor the speed of vehicles near the school, ensuring compliance with speed limits and other traffic laws.
  • Prevent unsafe behaviors such as illegal parking, jaywalking, and other violations in the school zone.
  • Communicate effectively with school staff, parents, and students about traffic procedures and safety protocols.
  • Report any traffic accidents, incidents, or unsafe conditions to the school administration and local law enforcement.
  • Provide assistance and directions to visitors, staff, and parents regarding appropriate parking and traffic routes.
  • Act quickly and efficiently in case of an emergency, including vehicle accidents, medical emergencies, or other urgent situations near the school.
  • Coordinate with emergency responders (police, fire department, or medical teams) as needed in emergency situations.
  • Identify potential traffic issues or congestion points around the school and suggest or implement improvements to traffic patterns.
  • Provide feedback to the school administration and local authorities about traffic-related concerns or areas that require further attention.
  • Maintain accurate records of traffic incidents, accidents, or violations that occur during shifts.
  • Report any issues related to traffic control devices (e.g., traffic lights, signs) that may require attention or repair.


Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in traffic control, law enforcement, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of traffic laws, pedestrian safety protocols, and school zone regulations.
  • The ability to remain calm and focused in high-pressure or stressful situations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with students, staff, parents, and the community.
  • Ability to work outdoors in various weather conditions.
  • Certification in traffic safety or a related field (preferred but not required).
  • Must possess a valid driver's license.


Physical Demands:

  • Ability to walk or move around the school grounds to direct traffic, assist pedestrians, and respond to emergencies.
  • Requires regular physical labor including lifting, carrying, bending, climbing, and operating tools and machinery.
  • Must be capable of lifting a minimum of 50 lbs.
  • Work may be conducted indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.


TO APPLY:

Submit your application through the school's website. All applicants should include a cover letter, current résumé and three professional references (including your most recent direct supervisor).

The Awty International School does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, ethnic or religious beliefs, disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law in administration of its educational policies, admissions policies, scholarship and athletic and other school-administered programs or in its employment practices.

jobs.title: Campus Security Guard - Episcopal High School, Houston
jobs.description:
The Campus Security Guard supports a safe, secure, and welcoming school environment for students, faculty, staff, and visitors. This position is responsible for monitoring campus activity, enforcing safety procedures, assisting with emergency response, and supporting daily operations and special events in alignment with the school’s mission and values.

Job Requirements

  • Maintain a safe and secure campus environment during school hours, before and after school activities, and special events.
  • Monitor campus access points, parking lots, event areas, student arrival and dismissal, and visitor activity.
  • Operate and monitor security systems, including cameras, gate access controls, door access controls, and lockdown systems; assist with basic troubleshooting as needed.
  • Provide leadership and direction to off-duty police officers and contracted security personnel when assigned.
  • Assist the Director of Operations and the Director of Safety & Security with scheduling security coverage for special events.
  • Support faculty and staff parking operations, including assignment of spaces and distribution of parking permits and RFID tags.
  • Direct traffic safely and effectively before and after school and during major campus events.
  • Respond calmly and appropriately to emergencies and safety concerns in accordance with established protocols.
  • Accurately document and report all incidents, accidents, and safety concerns using required procedures and forms.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by school leadership.
  • Support and uphold the school’s mission, values, and community standards.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required

  • Minimum of four (4) years of security experience.
  • Bachelor’s or Associate Degree
  • Ability to conduct security patrols independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency or willingness to learn security-related technology, including video monitoring, access control, and alarm systems.
  • Ability to complete routine reports and documentation accurately and on time.
  • Ability to safely operate motor vehicles, both electric and gas-powered.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions, procedures, and safety protocols.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, professionalism, and a customer-service mindset when working with students, families, staff, and visitors.
  • Ability to remain calm, make sound judgments, and act effectively in emergency or high-stress situations.
  • Ability to identify potential safety hazards or security risks and report concerns promptly to appropriate personnel.

Working Conditions and Physical Effort

  • Work may involve moderate exposure to outdoor conditions, including heat, cold, and inclement weather.
  • Position requires moderate physical activity, including standing or walking for extended periods and lifting or carrying items up to 50 pounds.
